name: FLY FIBRA
name_long: Fly Fibra Servicos de Internet LTDA
notes:
AS266182 is a regional Internet Service Provider (ISP) based in Sorriso, Mato Grosso, Brazil, providing Internet connectivity to residential and business customers across Sorriso and surrounding areas. 

The network operates both IPv4 and IPv6 and is continuously expanding its regional presence and interconnection capacity. We welcome peering and interconnection opportunities that can improve routing efficiency, network resilience, and connectivity for our customers. For peering, routing, or technical matters, please use the NOC contact information listed on this PeeringDB profile.
